approach: Static recompilation of the XBLA version with ReXGlue, with a native OGRE 14 renderer
notes: v1.0 out. Requires your own copy of the XBLA game. Native OGRE renderer, portable by default, gamepad-friendly setup. Supports Torchlight PC mods (items, monsters, classes, textures) and texture packs, PC saves (experimental), and imported PC languages. Android build is highly experimental: tested mostly on a POCO X7 and a Galaxy A07. macOS is Apple Silicon only; Linux needs an x86-64-v3 CPU.
help: Testing on more Android phones and tablets
Artists: PlayStation and Nintendo button icons in the game's own style (today they are Kenney's CC0 set)
